body: Owner 7 Nov 2026 (D-66): wants to pick where to play (another phone on the same account, a browser) from the player, tested with the real phone and an emulator. It is at position 76 of Now and needs P2-08 and P2-09 (positions 65, 66; playback state and one device at a time). It is a multi-day piece (size L). A browser device needs the web client, which is not planned in Now. Moving it up the list is yours to do on the board.
